RATE[], S, CAP_RATIO, cells and RANKS are all fixed at 57d31dde; N_ITER is the ONLY input any arm can move and section 5.5 is the ONLY rule that may move it. THE 293.0 AND 313.0 IN THIS ENTRY ARE THE N_ITER = 400 READINGS. If ARM-P accepts only at 80 < n <= 400, or ARM-F fires, the launcher recomputes the ladder cap and every wall allowance from that same frozen arithmetic with the new N_ITER, and this entry's numbers are then the N_ITER = 400 baseline rather than the running cap -- disclosed here so a later reader is not misled by a static number.
